scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "npm run dev --workspace @goease/client" "npm run dev --workspace @goease/server"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @goease/client
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @goease/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run build --workspace @goease/server && npm run build --workspace @goease/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @goease/contracts && npm run test --workspace @goease/server
